_about: The one list of topics used on dafyomiinsights.com, for articles and stories. Style: Title Case, 1-5 words (shorter is better), the site's Ashkenazi transliteration (Shabbos, Berachos, Kesubah), 'and' not '&'. A topic is a subject: never a citation (Magen Avraham 147:5), a masechta or daf (they have their own pages), or a person (sages are on the Stories by Sage pages). 'aliases' are old or alternative names; they all point to the topic, so never add a new topic that is already someone's alias. 'retired' lists old tags that are not topics at all. Edit this file to add a topic; scripts/topics/check.mjs checks it.
